evidence.quote:
Saumil Bandyopadhyay
Postdoctoral Fellow
Saumil Bandyopadhyay’s research in the PHI Lab is focused on developing photonic systems for artificial intelligence. He received his Ph.D. in Electrical Engineering from MIT, where his S.B and M.Eng. were also conferred. Saumil’s doctoral work focused on building programmable silicon photonic processors for deep neural networks

Single-chip photonic deep neural network with forward-only training
Topic: Neural Networks and Reservoir Computing
Keywords: photonic neural networks, coherent optical processing, photonic integrated circuits
CTO of Opticore and Senior Scientist / Group Head at NTT Research. Also a visiting scientist at MIT EECS / RLE.

New year, new adventure. Starting this January, I will be joining the optical computing startup Opticore as their CTO. Around a year ago we founded Opticore, a startup to commercialize the technologies we conceived and proved back at MIT. I'm also happy that Kazuhiro (Kazu) Gomi and Yoshihisa Yamamoto have allowed me to remain involved part-time at NTT Research, so this will not be a good-bye to my NTT colleagues.
